title: Hint response (PROPOSED, not built yet)
description: Response of POST /api/v1/encounters/{id}/hints. Request body: { level } where level is 1, 2 or 3. 1 is a nudge, 2 points at the approach, 3 is the walkthrough. Levels must be asked in order: a player can only ask for level N after asking levels 1 to N-1 (asking an already-asked level again is allowed and returns the same text). Errors: 404 if the encounter does not exist; 409 if an earlier level has not been asked yet (body {"detail": "Ask hint level 1 first"}); 422 if level is not 1 to 3.
